$comment: Traceability matrix: every bullet of the pdfnative CHANGELOG entry named by `engine` is either exercised THROUGH the MCP server (named tests, and baseline samples where a sample can show it) or waived with a reason. tests/engine-surface.test.ts holds every reference to the tree. Extend it in the same change that moves the pdfnative pin (CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Bumping the engine pin'). Item ids and changelog prefixes are shared with pdfnative-cli's matrix, so the two wrappers can be compared line by line. Waiver kinds: LIB (a JavaScript API a JSON tool call cannot reach), TOOLING / DOCS (the engine repository's own build, CI, samples or documentation), tested-upstream (a rule of the engine the server only transmits — `transmission` names the suite that proves the transmission), upstream-limit (observable through the server but wrong or incomplete in the engine; see `upstreamLimits`).
